resources.string: Add, rename, recolor, or delete the categories bills are sorted into.
No items recorded yet. Items appear here once you scan a bill.
Is this the receipt you just photographed?
Choose how Bill Scanner finds the photo you just took in the camera app. Try both and keep whichever works best on your phone.
Detects the new photo as soon as you return to Bill Scanner.
You tap \"Find my photo\" yourself after returning. More reliable on some phones.
Take your photo in the camera app, then come back here and tap the button below.
Open the camera app to photograph a receipt
Pick a photo you already took
Add a bill without a photo, e.g. if you lost the receipt
The \"Other\" category can\'t be deleted \u2014 it\'s used as the fallback for uncategorized bills.
Delete \"%1$s\"? No bills currently use this category.
"%1$d bill(s) currently use \"%2$s\". Choose a category to move them to before deleting:"
Add any notes about this bill (optional)
No bills scanned yet. Tap the camera button to add your first one.
Camera permission is needed to scan bills.
Delete this bill? This cannot be undone.
Recognized as %1$s \u2014 fields filled from a verified template

Saves every bill\'s photo (renamed) and all entered details as a JSON file into your phone\'s Pictures and Downloads folders, and also offers to share a single zip of everything. Nothing is uploaded anywhere.
Exported %1$d bill(s), %2$d photo(s) to Pictures/BillScannerExport and Downloads/BillScannerExport.
Exported %1$d bill(s), %2$d photo(s) (%3$d bill(s) had no readable photo). Saved to Pictures/BillScannerExport and Downloads/BillScannerExport.
By default, deleting a bill in the app leaves its photo saved. Turn this on to also delete the photo itself.

When you correct a bill\'s store name or category, the app remembers that shop (using its address/phone from the receipt text) and applies your correction automatically next time. Nothing is sent anywhere — it\'s stored only on this device.
A local record of what was auto-extracted, what you corrected, and what the app learned. Nothing leaves your device unless you tap Export.
Nothing logged yet. Scan or correct a bill to see entries here.
Delete the entire activity log? This cannot be undone.
Forget all learned stores? This cannot be undone.
Stores the app has learned a correction for. Matched automatically on future scans by stable text (address/phone) from the receipt, not by the store name itself.
No stores learned yet. Correct a bill\'s store name or category and save it to teach the app.
